ANALYSIS: Tracheobronchial rupture is a traumatic tear of the central airway, whereas persistent/recurrent pneumothorax from a bronchopleural/alveolopleural fistula describes an ongoing pleural air leak; these are distinct diagnoses (though a tracheobronchial tear can cause air leak, the predicted label does not identify airway rupture). Not clinically equivalent.
